**Flight:** Sat 2 Jan – Tue 12 Jan 2027 (UK time) • **Status:** Ended (expired as scheduled)

Since you have no X pixel or app ID, I ran this as a **link-clicks** campaign on X, sending people to https://thimblepot.co.uk/new-year where the install happens. So X's reported metric is link clicks; actual installs will show in your app analytics.
